{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Structured wool-blend blazer, sharp cut, hip-length, charcoal gray (#3a4045), heavy twill.
Relaxed-fit silk blouse, soft drape, hip-length, cream white (#f5f5dc), lightweight chiffon.
High-waisted wide-leg trousers, tapered leg, below ankle, navy blue (#1b2a4f), stretch ponte knit.
Ankle boots, rounded toe, heel height 6cm, saddle brown (#8b6b58), smooth leather.

This outfit works by using the structured blazer and high-waisted wide-leg trousers to create a clean vertical line that visually conceals the belly as requested. The relaxed silk blouse adds necessary comfort for an autumn office day without clinging to the midsection, maintaining a polished professional appearance. The neutral color palette of charcoal, cream, and navy keeps the focus on the silhouette's lines rather than drawing attention to any specific area."}
